🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — October 27, 2026

Moon, exalted in Taurus, holds a square to Jupiter, in Leo. Two ways of valuing a thing, meeting at one point: the wanting and the sum are audible in the same room.

Easier — Noticing which of your commitments you never actually chose.
Harder — Forcing a decision that only needs to be described honestly.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus have just closed a sextile, new under everything else.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, moves through Leo unannounced. Venus in Libra sits opposite: your figure meets somebody else’s. Fire opens the file, and the file has a price. The opposition of a week ago is off it now.

♉ TAURUS
Venus, your ruler, is on home ground in Libra. Moon is inside your sign, at arm’s length. Earth holds until owning and being coincide. Venus left Scorpio four weeks ago, and the old terms went with it.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury governs you, untitled in Scorpio. Jupiter sextiles you from Leo: an opening to be reached for. Mutable air: two answers, and both are affordable. Mercury has been out of Libra for four weeks now.

♋ CANCER
Moon governs you, honoured in Taurus. Sun in Scorpio flows toward you — nothing resists, which is the risk. Water that starts things, started cheaply. Mercury let go of it a week ago.

♌ LEO
Sun rules you from Scorpio, untitled. Moon in Taurus presses on you, and the pressure is arithmetic. Fire that holds on, charged for holding. Sun has not been in Libra for four weeks.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury rules you and passes through Scorpio as a guest. From Taurus, Moon concedes the point early. Earth adapts, and adapting costs nothing here. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♎ LIBRA
Venus governs you, at home in Libra. Jupiter in Leo opens a gap you have to step into. Air moves first here, and first is enough. Two weeks ago Venus was still held by Mars; that is finished.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. From Taurus, Moon quotes your worth back at you. Water keeps its grip past the point it is worth. This was not here last week, and has no history yet.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. Venus in Libra leaves a door ajar; nothing walks through it alone. Fire that changes shape, and the shape fits. The hold Sun had a week ago is not there any more.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. Moon in Taurus sides with you before you have argued. Cardinal earth: beginning costs almost nothing. The opposition to Sun that held three weeks ago has let go.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. Moon squares you from Taurus: wanting and cost refuse to agree. Fixed air pays to hold on. New since last week: none of it is habit yet.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, holds no rank in Leo and simply works. From Taurus, Moon offers an angle — offered, not delivered. Water bends, and bending costs nothing here. It arrived inside the last seven days.
